title: 第一切片贯通输入输出
premise: 承诺缩小，拆成行为基线、一个报表切片和后续可选工作。
listeningTask: 区分贯通切片与只做某一层的横向拆分。

lines.en: The first vertical slice covers daily reporting. Input parsing, transformation, and output work together.
lines.zh: 首个贯通切片覆盖日报，输入解析、转换、输出连起来。

lines.en: That's better than extracting every helper first. We can validate an actual consumer workflow.
lines.zh: 比先提取所有辅助函数好，可以验证真实使用流程。

lines.en: Just to confirm, baseline tests come first, right? Then Raj can be heads-down on extraction.
lines.zh: 确认一下，基线测试先做，对吧？之后Raj专注提取。

lines.en: I'm on it with the sanitized fixtures. Maybe the failure samples need an extra day.
lines.zh: 脱敏fixture我来做，失败样本可能额外需要一天。

lines.en: A characterization test runs before each extraction. Afterward it compares the same input outputs.
lines.zh: 每次提取前跑行为测试，之后对比同一输入输出。

lines.en: I'll keep the existing CLI entry point. Internal modules won't change the scheduled invocation.
lines.zh: 保留原CLI入口，内部模块不改变调度调用。

lines.en: Use small reviewable changes with passing tests. A giant final merge raises comparison risk.
lines.zh: 小改动、可评审、测试通过，大量最终合并增加对照风险。

lines.en: One action item is defining each review boundary. Raj implements, Lukas reviews, Hannah verifies behavior.
lines.zh: 一项任务是明确每次评审边界，Raj实现、Lukas评审、Hannah验证。

lines.en: The second report remains optional this iteration. Its tests mustn't silently replace first-slice acceptance.
lines.zh: 第二份报表本轮可选，其测试不能悄悄替代首个切片验收。

lines.en: Good, consumers will see a complete example. That makes feedback useful before broader extraction.
lines.zh: 好，使用方能看到完整例子，扩大提取前反馈更有用。

scene: 承诺缩小，拆成行为基线、一个报表切片和后续可选工作。
dir: coding/0201-第一切片贯通输入输出
